title: Keep client concurrency inside one host envelope
description: Change workload shape, client demand, backend pool width, shared cache, and per-operator memory. The model shows why max_connections and work_mem cannot be tuned independently.

workloads.label: Short transactions
workloads.detail: Indexed reads and small writes keep active queries brief, so a modest backend pool can serve many clients.

workloads.label: Mixed application traffic
workloads.detail: Joins, sorts, and writes overlap. More sessions are active and each plan may allocate several work_mem operators.

workloads.label: Concurrent reporting
workloads.detail: Long scans and aggregations hold backends and memory for longer. Pooling protects the server but cannot create analytical capacity.
